{{Quote|We're headed for a moon in the Ryloth system, Threepio. As far as the Galactic Travel Guide is concerned, it's ''uninhabited'' and ''inhospitable''.''"<br />"''Oh dear, I'm afraid I'm more confused than ''ever''. Why would we be going ''there''?''"<br />"''Because it's really ''neither''. I have an&hellip; old friend&hellip; who lives there. Someone I knew a long time ago. Someone from ''Alderaan''.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Empire 20" />}}
This '''unidentified moon''' was one of the five [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]],<ref name="Moon" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Gaulus sector/Legends|Gaulus sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
{{Quote|You ''see'' what you've brought here? You and your ''Rebellion?''<nowiki></nowiki>''"<br />"''What happened has nothing to do with&mdash;''"<br />"''My brother would be ''alive'' if you'd just left us alone. But you couldn't ''do'' that, and now ''one more'' piece of Alderaan is lost forever. I want you ''gone,'' Leia. You and your Rebel friends can forget you ''ever'' knew this place existed.|[[Heeth Panteer]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], shortly after the death of [[Raal Panteer]]|<ref name="Empire 21" />}}
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] went to this [[Moon/Legends|moon]] to scout its potential as a new [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base, but was eventually unsuccessful.<ref name="Empire 21" /><ref name="TEA" />
